text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, Tanino Gimlet dragged two Umamusume along
and declared the following."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To create an incomparable, one-of-a-kind sweet nectar!!
For that sake—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We must seek out the ingredients for nectar...
Set forth now, adventurers!!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide & Brian
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...That's everything we were asked to get.
Sorry for making you help out.
choice_data_list: No, Gimlet was the one who brought it up in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's keeping Tanino Gimlet company after she suddenly
decided to host a mocktail party.
I'm the one who should be apologizing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well.
In the end, Brian wouldn't budge an inch anyway—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Gimlet's abruptness hasn't changed a bit, has it? Ever since the old days.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, they're not quite an acquaintance, but...
You know how Brian and I both have families running liquor stores?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just once, when I was young, I accompanied my father for his work.
We visited Gimlet-kun's father's bar.
It was a very long time ago, though...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: After spending the whole day playing together like kids do... when the time finally came to part ways, young Brian sulked quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Gimlet, who was watching that, suddenly
started making juice in the kitchen—"

text_block_list.name: Young Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, drink.
It doesn't have a name yet, but...
it's a farewell drink between you and me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It was just a regular mixed juice, but...
it was delicious, not too sweet.
Brian cheered up, too."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Though, that was a very long time ago.
So long that even Brian has forgotten...
I doubt Gimlet remembers either.
choice_data_list: So it's a flavor that only exists in memory.
So it's a flavor that only exists in your memories.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...We ended up talking for a while.
Let's head back soon.
The two of them must be tired of waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the mocktail party got underway, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......Naive.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is plain nectar too sweet?
Then――how about this?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Titled "Tears of Chronos"...
It may be a faux Bacchus, but it packs quite a punch.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm, this is... it's certainly not sweet, but...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I'm heading back to the dorms.
It would be far more productive to change and start solo training.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait.
...The main event starts here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that smile,
what Tanino Gimlet took out was—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An incomparable, one-of-a-kind sweet nectar—
'Childhood Farewell'.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...!
This is from back then...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I hope this isn't some overly sweet juice made for little kids again...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Take a sip.
The lingering aroma that follows
will beckon you—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The radiance of the past residing there
only adds further brilliance to the present.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. ...That's a nice name for it.
It's as delicious as always.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"What in the world have you two
been talking about this whole time...?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that.
—So, how does it taste?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Not really. ...It's just—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —It's a strangely nostalgic flavor.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A peaceful time flows by.
It seems the modest memories shared by the three of them
were truly precious treasures.
choice_data_list: It's a memorable flavor for you too, huh?
So it's a taste full of memories for you as well.
I wonder what the secret ingredient is, huh...
I wonder what the secret ingredient is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A peaceful time flows by.
It seems the modest memories shared by the three of them
were truly precious treasures.
choice_data_list: It's a memorable flavor for you too, huh?
So it's a taste full of memories for you as well.
I wonder what the secret ingredient is, huh...
I wonder what the secret ingredient is...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, not a bad way to spend time, is it?
I'll get something for you too, Trainer.
Let's see, if it's for you—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we call it 'Wonderful Days'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I swirled my glass, silently wishing that these days, too,
would one day become irreplaceable memories.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I'm not telling ya!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... A mystery should remain a mystery, wouldn't you say?
If I had to say... the mystery itself is the ultimate secret ingredient.
choice_data_list: Ehh... Hayahide, you wanna know too, right?
Ehh... Hayahide, you wanna know too, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, it is a bit of a shame, but... That is so like you, Gimlet-kun."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Come by for another drink sometime.
âThough whether I can mix one depends
on the god of drunkenness's mood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A peaceful time passes by... I swirled my glass, hoping that these days would one day become irreplaceable memories.
